message.text: Hi, what day is rent due each month, and is there a grace period?

input.query: Hi, what day is rent due each month, and is there a grace period?

result.heading: 4.1 Rent due date
result.text: Rent is due on the 1st day of each month. A grace period runs through the 5th day of the month. Rent received after the 5th incurs a $75 late fee.

result.heading: 4.3 Payment methods
result.text: Rent can be paid by autopay, one-time online payment in the resident portal, or certified check at the office. If an autopay fails, pay the balance online within 5 days to avoid a late fee.
